prashna_chapter1_verse4.title: Prashna Chapter 1 Verse 4
prashna_chapter1_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Prashna, Chapter 1.
prashna_chapter1_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Prashna Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
prashna_chapter1_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
